key: Lapis is the richest ward in Reborn.
en: Lapis is the richest ward in Reborn.
ja: ラピスは、リボーンで一番裕福なワードだ。

key: Unfortunately, that also makes it a prime target for gang activity.
en: Unfortunately, that also makes it a prime target for gang activity.
ja: 残念ながら、そのせいでギャング活動の格好の標的にもなっている。

key: None of the elderly folks want to do any labor for helping the city out themselves...
en: None of the elderly folks want to do any labor for helping the city out themselves...
ja: 年寄り連中は、自分で街のために働こうなんて誰も思っちゃいない……

key: But you can bet we've squeezed a pretty penny out of them to cover repair costs!
en: But you can bet we've squeezed a pretty penny out of them to cover repair costs!
ja: でも、修理費用のためにあいつらからしっかり金を絞り取ってやったのは間違いない!
